description:
The agent must open SKILL.md to discover the full taxonomy of 24 AI writing patterns and the soul-injection requirements. It must then:
1. Remove all collaborative chatbot artifacts ('Here is an overview', 'I hope this helps', 'Let me know') — Pattern 19.
2. Fix curly/smart quotes to straight ASCII quotes — Pattern 18 (non-obvious typographic fix).
3. Convert the Title Case heading to sentence case — Pattern 16.
4. Collapse the emoji + inline-header bullet list into prose — Patterns 15 (inline headers) and 17 (emojis).
5. Remove em dash overuse — Pattern 13.
6. Remove significance inflation language ('testament', 'pivotal moment', 'evolving landscape') — Pattern 1.
7. Remove AI vocabulary words ('groundbreaking', 'vibrant', 'nestled', 'breathtaking', 'seamless', 'unparalleled', 'boasts') — Pattern 7.
8. Remove vague attribution ('Industry experts believe') — Pattern 5.
9. Remove the formulaic Challenges boilerplate ('Despite its...faces several challenges...Despite these challenges...continues to thrive') — Pattern 6.
10. Remove negative parallelisms ('It's not just...it's...') — Pattern 9.
11. Remove the rule of three ('powerful integrations, seamless workflows, and unparalleled performance') — Pattern 10.
12. Fix elegant variation/synonym cycling ('main system / core platform / central engine / primary solution') — Pattern 11.
13. Remove the false range ('from the chaos of... to the precision of...') — Pattern 12.
14. Remove sycophantic language ('Great question — you're absolutely right') — Pattern 21.
15. Remove knowledge-cutoff disclaimer — Pattern 20.
16. Remove excessive hedging ('could potentially possibly') — Pattern 23.
17. Remove generic positive conclusion — Pattern 24.
18. Remove excess bold formatting — Pattern 14.
19. Inject soul: add first-person opinion, specific numbers/details, varied sentence rhythm — per the PERSONALITY AND SOUL section of SKILL.md.
20. Save as `launch_announcement_final.md`.
